book.name: Rom
book.title: Pol nainge tup nal lenge Rom

content: Lenge Israel yukur sisyeme yaŋah bwore bwore tikin Got

Lenge toꞌ tatai ŋam, ŋoihmbwaip ŋam eꞌe pe, ki ŋasande ŋaiye Got ka ungwisme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge Israel ŋaiye tinge bamtihei ŋam. Pe ŋam manange wusyep misilihme Got bongol sekete ŋaiye ka ungwisme tinge.
Ŋam sisyeme tinge bworerme pe, ŋam manange taꞌe leꞌe. Tinge bongol supule ŋaiye jande yaŋah bwore bwore tikin Got ŋaiye kin ŋasande. Kom wah nihe tinge yukur gande ŋasande tikin Got.

Taꞌe luku pe, tinge yukur sisyeme yaŋah ŋaiye Got ŋende me poi miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ya murp bwore bwarme tuꞌe kitikin. Tinge jande yaŋah ŋoinde tititinge pe, tinge yukur yarp tuwihme Got no, ka ende tinge ka yurp miyeꞌ bwore bwarme.

Wah ŋaiye jande wusyep erŋeme si miꞌe. Detale, Krais kumbur kohmap ŋambaran ŋaiye poi ya murp bwore bwarme mil ŋembep tikin Got. Taꞌe luku pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme ŋaiye yaŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip tinge yalme Krais pe, tinge ka yurp bwore bwarme yil ŋembep tikin Got.
Got de ka ungwisme lenge mitiŋ lalme
Moses nainge wusyep na, ŋaiye lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge yasande ŋaiye ka yurp laip pe, ka junde wusyep erŋeme lalme.

Kom yaŋah ŋaiye na orp bwore bwarme topoꞌme Got pe, ŋoihmbwaip nin ka teŋeime Krais. Yukur na ŋoiheryembe tuꞌe leꞌe, “Lahmende tatame ŋaiye ka e unuh moihlaꞌ ŋaiye ka etekeꞌe Krais no, ka enge Krais ote guh?”
Topoꞌe yukur pa se yininge na, “Lahmende tatame ka se e guh luh moi lenge miyeꞌ yule ŋaiye si yule?” Ki taꞌe ŋaiye ni plihe nala ahraꞌe Jisas osme ŋeheh unuh.
Kom wusyep tehei ŋaiye wusyep uku ki ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Wusyep uku ki sai sehei me yip ŋaiye tahaiꞌ nato ŋoihmbwaip yip
topoꞌe mut yip.
Wusyep ŋaiye poi manange malaŋatme pe,
poi manange malme yaŋah ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip yip
ka teŋeime Krais bongol.

content: O ŋaiye mut nin uku na ininge oworꞌe ember el halhale nange Jisas kin Lahmborenge, topoꞌe nato ŋoihmbwaip meleꞌe nin uku ka teŋei bongol me Krais nange Got nahraꞌe kin nasme nule pe, Got se ka ungwisme nin.

Ŋoihmbwaip poi ŋaiye ka teŋei bongol me Krais pe, Got se ka gil poi nange poi miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye marp bwore bwarme. Topoꞌe ŋaiye mut poi ya mininge moworꞌe member ŋoiheryembe mise poi pe, Got se ka ungwisme poi.
Ki taꞌe wusyep ŋaiye sai nato tup ŋana poi na, “Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime kin pe, yukur ka se hiꞌe.”

Lenge Juta topoꞌ lenge mitiŋ ŋaiye yukur Juta pe, tinge ŋahilyeh lalme. Lahmborenge ilyeh uku pe, kin Lahmborenge poi lalme. Kin ŋasambe ŋoihmbwaip bwore kin nalme lenge mitiŋ lalme ŋaiye yisilihme kin nange ka ungwisme tinge.
Taꞌe luku pe, lahmende miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ka jil naŋ Got yisilihme kin ŋaiye ka ungwisme tinge pe, Got se ka ungwisme tinge.

Kom ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge yukur teŋeime kin pe, tinge ka yisilihme kin tuꞌe lai ti, ka ungwisme tinge? Topoꞌe ŋaiye tinge yukur yisande wusyep kin pe, ka se yaŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip tinge yilme Krais tuꞌe lai? Topoꞌe ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende yukur nal ŋanange nalaŋatme wusyep nalme tinge pe, ka se yusyunde wusyep kin tuꞌe la?
Topoꞌe lahmende ka se ininge wusyep uku ŋaiye yip yukur yember lenge mitiŋ yal tas ŋaiye ka yininge yalaŋatme wusyep uku? Wusyep ŋaiye sai nato Tup tikin Got ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye yenge wusyep bwore mise yat pe,
ŋihip tinge bwore miꞌ supule.

content: Lenge Israel yukur yisande wusyep bwore mise

Kom yukur lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme jande wusyep bwore mise luku, pakai. Aisaia ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe, “Lahmborenge, lahmende ka aŋaꞌe ŋoihmbwaip kin elme wusyep eꞌe ŋaiye poi manange malaŋatme malme tinge?”
Tinge yanange yalaŋatme poi wusyep bwore tikin Krais pe, ki ŋende ŋoihmbwaip poi ka teŋeime wusyep uku ŋaiye poi masande.
Kom detaꞌe lai me lenge Juta miyeꞌ tuweinge? Tinge yisande wusyep uku, lakai pakai? Hei! Tinge si yisande kili.

content.text: Poi sisyeme, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme
ŋaiye nalꞌe nalꞌe kekep lalme pe,
tinge si yisande wusyep mise tikin Got.
Pe wusyep tikin Got si nalꞌe nalꞌe nato moi ilyeh ilyeh kekep lalme.

content: Topoꞌe ŋam de ma plihe misilih na, taꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge Israel yukur sisyeme wusyep tehei ŋaiye wusyep uku, lakai pakai? Tinge si sisyeme. Moses kin ŋendehei ŋaiye ŋanange nalaŋatme wusyep Got uku.

content.text: Ŋam ma mende yip ŋaiye pa ternenge sisingir me lenge mitiŋ
ŋaiye yukur kekep ilyeh yip.
Topoꞌe ma mende yip pa tuhwarme lenge haiten,
ŋaiye yip ŋoiheryembe ŋaiye tinge sande tekeꞌe pakai.

content: Topoꞌe Aisaia, kin plihe ŋanange wusyep bongol taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye yukur yaha yahaiꞌe ŋam pe,
tinge se ka yetekeꞌe ŋam.
Ŋam menge ŋam tanam mate masambe ŋam mal lenge mitiŋ
ŋaiye yukur yisilih yahaiꞌ ŋam.

content: Kom wusyep ŋaiye Aisaia ŋanange nal lenge Israel pe, ki ŋanange taꞌe leꞌe,

content.text: Ŋup ilyeh ilyeh pe, ŋam gwal lenge pe, ŋam marp meseperhme
ŋaiye ma mungwisme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye yende sisyoꞌe
topoꞌe yengelyembe wusyep ŋam.
